title: World Bank WDI: India GDP (current US$), 2025
finding: Calendar 2025 current-dollar GDP US$3,956,067,115,771.6, below US$5 trillion.
limitations: Calendar year vs fiscal year interpretation must be stated.

title: Jal Jeevan Mission parliamentary response, 31 March 2025
finding: As of 31 March 2025, 80.38% of rural households reported tap water connections against the original universal-by-2024 target.
limitations: State-reported connection counts do not establish continuity and quality.

title: JJM parliamentary response, March 2026
finding: 81.71% rural households reportedly connected as of 3 March 2026.
limitations: Shows substantial gains despite missed original deadline.

title: Prime Minister launched National Agriculture Market
finding: Pilot National Agriculture Market e-NAM launched in 21 mandis in eight states.
limitations: Launch is not proof of unified agricultural market operation nationwide.

title: Cabinet approved National Health Policy 2017
finding: National Health Policy 2017 approved by Cabinet on 15 March 2017.
limitations: Policy approval is narrower than universal coverage or reduced health costs.

title: Cabinet extends free food grains for five years from January 2024
finding: Five-year continuation announced and approved before 2024 election manifesto.
limitations: A pre-election extension is not new post-election delivery; implementation should be monitored.

title: Food Ministry year-end review
finding: Ministry reports free-food scheme extended and active during 2024.
limitations: Government self-report of administrative implementation.

title: Ayushman Vay Vandana launched for residents aged 70+
finding: Coverage extension launched 29 October 2024 and 10 lakh senior citizens enrolled by November.
limitations: Implementation milestone not universal senior enrollment.

title: Ayushman programme enrollment update
finding: Government reports 1.20 crore seniors enrolled as of June 2026.
limitations: Coverage/quality outcomes separate.

title: MUDRA loan limit extended with Tarun Plus conditions
finding: Upper ceiling ₹20 lakh effective October 2024 for eligible repeat borrowers.
limitations: Not an unconditional ₹20 lakh limit for every borrower.

title: Mudra lending eligibility confirmation
finding: 2026 parliamentary reply confirms Tarun Plus loans of ₹10–20 lakh available to qualifying repaid-loan customers.
limitations: Eligibility caveat is material.

title: Cabinet approved ₹1 lakh crore RDI Fund
finding: Cabinet approved ₹1 lakh crore Research, Development and Innovation scheme.
limitations: Approved corpus must not be represented as fully disbursed.

title: Parliamentary response on ANRF utilisation
finding: Reported ANRF fund allocations and utilisation; implementation exists, actual cash deployed lower than authorised corpus.
limitations: Reported lines include SERB and ANRF; do not sum without separating them.

title: Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2019 gazette
issuer: Ministry of Home Affairs / Gazette of India
finding: Citizenship (Amendment) Act enacted in December 2019. This verifies legislative enactment, not its contested consequences.
limitations: Legal status and human-rights implications are independent questions.

title: Official account of Article 370 constitutional measures
finding: August 2019 constitutional orders and associated legislative steps altered Article 370 arrangements.
limitations: Legal changes are not equivalent to an assessment of their political or rights impact.

title: Anusandhan National Research Foundation Act, 2023
issuer: India Code, Ministry of Law & Justice
finding: Parliament enacted legislation establishing the ANRF, effective February 2024.
limitations: Legal establishment does not establish that promised research funding was spent.

title: Supreme Court Electoral Bonds judgment
finding: Court struck down Electoral Bonds scheme; source registry needs exact judgment URL for claim-level use.
limitations: No related manifesto promise assigned; listed as contextual research queue.

title: Parliament response: Price Stabilisation Fund established in 2014–15
finding: PSF was set up in 2014–15 for agricultural commodity buffer procurement and stabilisation.
limitations: Proves institutional setup, not that food inflation was controlled or sustained prices were achieved.

title: Price Stabilisation Fund allocations and operations 2014–25
finding: Reports original ₹500 crore corpus and later allocations and operational consolidation with PM-AASHA.
limitations: Government reporting of allocations and operations; not independent impact evaluation.

title: Government launch of National Skill Development Mission
finding: National Skill Development Mission and national skilling policy launched 15 July 2015.
limitations: Launch does not establish employability gains or net new jobs.

title: National Career Service launched July 2015
finding: The National Career Service portal became functional and was inaugurated 20 July 2015 alongside a model career-centre initiative.
limitations: Does not establish numbers successfully placed in jobs or service quality.

title: National Career Service portal and model career centres 2026
finding: Reports active portal, jobseeker and employer registrations, vacancy listings and Model Career Centres.
limitations: Vacancy postings and registrations are not confirmed actual jobs.

title: Rural digital-literacy training vs certification
finding: Government reports 6.39 crore trained under PMGDISHA by end-March 2024; 4.78 crore certified.
limitations: Training completion and certification differ; neither directly establishes long-run digital proficiency.

title: PMGDISHA programme approved and launched
finding: Government confirms February 2017 Cabinet approval to train one member from six crore rural households.
limitations: Programme objective, not evaluation of durable literacy gains.

title: World Bank Doing Business 2020 India profile
finding: India ranked 63 among 190 economies in the last published Doing Business edition.
limitations: Rank is from 2020 edition based on defined regulatory indicators; not a direct indicator of household prosperity.

title: World Bank discontinued Doing Business ranking
finding: World Bank officially discontinued the Doing Business report after reported data irregularities and reviews.
limitations: Cannot infer the hypothetical rank India would have attained in a subsequent edition.

title: Government launch of PM Kisan Maandhan pension scheme
issuer: Prime Minister Office / Ministry of Agriculture
finding: PM-KMY launched September 2019, offering voluntary contributory retirement benefits to eligible small and marginal farmers.
limitations: Scheme is not universal and its enrolment and pension delivery require separate scrutiny.

title: Farmers pension scheme enrolment by end of 2019
finding: Government year-end review reports over 19 lakh enrolments by late 2019.
limitations: Enrolment is not pension receipt or coverage rate of eligible farmers.

title: BharatNet service-ready coverage in June 2022
finding: Ministry reported 177,550 Gram Panchayats service-ready by June 2022, substantially short of universal coverage.
limitations: Service ready is not the same as active last-mile connections; 2022 midyear is before end-of-year deadline.

title: BharatNet coverage in October 2024
finding: As of October 2024, 214,283 GPs were service ready under BharatNet Phase I–II versus an estimated total around 264,000 GPs.
limitations: Scope / denominator and new amended programme require consistent definitions.

title: BharatNet coverage August 2026 parliamentary update
finding: Ministry reports approximately 2.21 lakh gram panchayats service-ready by June 2026.
limitations: Service-ready GPs may not be equivalent to functional broadband at all village households.

title: Independent RTI reporting on BharatNet last-mile use
finding: RTI-based reporting finds fewer than half of certain targeted last-mile connections actively using BharatNet service.
limitations: Measure concerns active last-mile connections, not the GP service-ready share; not directly interchangeable.

title: WHO global TB report 2025: India retains very high burden
finding: WHO estimates India accounted for about a quarter of global incident tuberculosis cases in 2024, inconsistent with elimination by that time.
limitations: Latest comparable 2025 burden estimates and a precise definition of elimination required for deadline-year verdict.

title: Finance Ministry notification on 20 lakh MUDRA credit ceiling
finding: Tarun Plus loan category from 24 October 2024 raised limit to ₹20 lakh for prior Tarun borrowers who fully repaid earlier loans.
limitations: Eligibility restricted; ceiling expansion is not evidence of universal access or employment generation.

title: Senior citizen 70+ PMJAY extension began October 2024
finding: Government confirms AB-PMJAY expansion 29 October 2024 and about 14 lakh Ayushman Vay Vandana cards generated by 29 November.
limitations: Issued cards do not equal usage or cashless treatment approval across providers.

title: Quantum mission four hubs operational with funds
finding: Four National Quantum Mission thematic hubs launched FY2024–25 and received funds to begin operations.
limitations: Does not establish quantum computing milestones or global competitiveness.

title: NQM operationalisation status August 2026
finding: Four thematic hubs and 17 project teams were reported operational; infrastructure under development.
limitations: Government self-report, not externally audited performance results.

title: BHASHINI multilingual services collaborations 2026
finding: Agreement to integrate Bhashini translation technologies into industry and investment services across the Eighth Schedule languages.
limitations: An MoU is a commitment to deploy, not proof of operational translations or service quality.

title: BHASHINI platform has multilingual contributor ecosystem
finding: Government reports Bhashini digital contributor platform and a 22-language transcription/translation tool.
limitations: Adoption and real-world accuracy require independent assessment.

title: IIT Kharagpur National Digital Library launch notice
issuer: National Digital Library of India / IIT Kharagpur
finding: National Digital Library of India was formally launched on 19 June 2018.
limitations: Establishment alone does not quantify active users, educational outcomes, breadth of accessible resources or digital equity.

title: Education ministry announces National Digital Library inauguration
finding: NDLI developed by IIT Kharagpur was inaugurated as a national learning-resource platform.
limitations: Government announcement of platform launch does not confirm effect on education quality.

title: NITI Aayog review of e-NAM integration
finding: Review notes cross-mandi purchases were few and far between during early rollout even as electronic market integration expanded.
limitations: Earlier implementation assessment; it cannot establish 2026 market integration without an updated comparable audit.

title: Peer-reviewed e-NAM implementation study in Rajasthan
finding: Scholarly implementation study tracks registrations, market participation and trade volumes following launch.
limitations: Regional example; cannot establish national price improvements.

title: Government account of e-NAM launch and market integration
finding: National Agricultural Market digital trading platform launched on 14 April 2016 and connected participating mandis.
limitations: Operational platform is not equivalent to a fully unified national market.

title: July 2014 proposed anti-hoarding legal amendments
finding: Government described proposed legal changes including non-bailable offences and special courts.
limitations: Proposed amendments are not evidence of enactment, court operation or deterrence.

title: Department of Consumer Affairs FAQ on special courts
finding: States may establish special courts or designate courts for essential commodities offences.
limitations: Legal authority does not demonstrate systematic establishment or implementation by each state.

title: 2014 ministry plans AIIMS in each state
finding: Ministry began asking states for proposed AIIMS-like institute locations.
limitations: Planning step alone does not prove all states have operating institutes.

title: 2026 health ministry approved and operational AIIMS
finding: Ministry reported 22 newly approved AIIMS under PMSSY, 18 fully functional and the others under construction.
limitations: Total approved institutes is not automatically equivalent to state-by-state universal coverage.

title: India HCES comparable real household consumption figures
finding: MoSPI reports real rural monthly per-capita consumption ₹1,430 in 2011–12 and ₹2,079 in 2023–24, with urban ₹2,630 and ₹3,632 respectively at 2011–12 prices.
limitations: Survey redesign and spacing over the 2011–12 to 2023–24 interval prevent annual causal inference; consumption is not wages.

title: World Bank India poverty and equity brief
finding: India lower-middle-income poverty at the $4.20/day (2021 PPP) threshold estimated at 57.7% in 2011–12 and 23.9% in 2022–23.
limitations: Poverty line changed; historical comparison requires consistent definitions and cannot prove policy attribution.

title: World Bank poverty threshold method update
finding: World Bank revised poverty thresholds and incorporated new Indian household consumption survey data.
limitations: 2025 and earlier published global poverty estimates are not interchangeable without harmonisation.
